::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 23d [1877]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)

I should like of all things to have the dear [Fernando](other_books/otherbook_741.qmd), but alas!  I don’t see a scrap of room for him before Christmas[^1]  [Orina](other_books/otherbook_877.qmd) will last till the summer  [Our Young ladies](other_books/otherbook_876.qmd) till Christmas, [Magnum Bonum](cmy_books/cmybook_131.qmd) 2 years - (I fear)  Then [Miss R N Carey](people/person_254.qmd) begins [a long story](other_books/otherbook_878.qmd) in July, and I can't see a chink to put any thing in till Our Young Ladies are done, & I suppose you cannot wait.

yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Endorsed 'NB post mark has Ja 29 at Winchester 1877'.
[^2]: Coleridge's novel *The Constant Prince* was about Prince Fernando of Portugal (1402-1443) and was eventually serialized in *MP* (January-June 1878.  The other fictions which were in its way were Harriet Romanoff, 'Orina', Euphemia Bussell, 'Our Young Ladies', CMY's own *Magnum Bonum* and Rosa Nouchette Carey, *Heriot's Choice*.
